title: Cohomology of an empty topological space
statement: Let $X$ be an empty topological space, $q$ a nonnegative integer and $F$ an abelian sheaf on $X$. Then $H^q(X,F)$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero, including $q=0$.

source.place: Proposition 02UZ, empty-space base case; Mathlib zero-stalk criterion

proof.text: The stalkwise zero-object criterion is vacuous because X has no points. Apply Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero, Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Abelian.lean:90, to obtain IsZero F. The additive Ext functor in its second variable preserves zero objects; its value at the free abelian sheaf on the terminal open is H^q(X,F). This is exactly Functor.map_isZero (extFunctorObj _ q) hF.
